# Review CHANGES REQUESTED for PAN-4402

# Review — PAN-4402
## Verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED — menu/tray "Use This Computer" in remote mode quits the app on Linux and Windows instead of switching to this computer

## Context
- Run ID: agent-pan-4402-review-96a5138c
- Manifest: /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-4402/.pan/review/agent-pan-4402-review-96a5138c/context.json
- Branch / workspace: feature/pan-4402 · /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-4402
- PR: https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/4665
- HEAD reviewed: 96a5138c23c032096c9ec6d2c8b2ae1215621415
- Base / prior cycle SHA: merge-base 333d44156a83 · no prior review cycle

## Blocking Findings

### [correctness] Menu/tray "Use This Computer" destroys the last window, which quits the app — `apps/desktop/src/main.ts:443-456`
- Severity: ! MUST
- Classification / requirement scope: implementation defect; in_pr_scope (FR-6, W-7)
- Trigger and changed-code connection: the app shows a chosen machine (remote mode) and the connect window is closed — the normal state, because `openRemoteDashboard` closes the connect window on success (`main.ts:428`). The operator clicks **Use This Computer** in the Overdeck menu (`menu.ts:181-185`) or the tray (`tray.ts:89-93`). Both call `useThisComputer()` → `switchToLocal({ closeConnectWindow: true })`. That function calls `destroyDashboardWindows()` (`main.ts:450`), which `destroy()`s the main window and every terminal window. No window is left. The existing `window-all-closed` handler (`main.ts:607-612`) sets `isQuitting = true` and calls `app.quit()` on every platform except macOS.
- Expected / observed / impact: FR-6 says **Use This Computer** "closes remote windows and starts the embedded server, which opens the local window as today." Instead, on Linux and Windows the app quits. `setMachineActive(false)` already ran, so the next manual launch is local, but the click itself closes the app. The function's own comment (`main.ts:438-441`) names this hazard ("closing it never leaves the app with no window (window-all-closed would quit)") and avoids it only for the connect-window path, where the connect window stays open. The menu and tray paths have no window to keep. A secondary, unconfirmed effect: `before-quit` runs `stopServer()` before `switchToLocal` reaches `startLocalServer()`, so the embedded `server.js` may be spawned during quit.
- Evidence: isolated Electron 40.10.6 probe (the workspace's own `apps/desktop/node_modules/electron`, scratch dir, `show: false` window). Calling `win.destroy()` on the only window printed, in this order: `EVENT window-all-closed fired`, `EVENT before-quit`, `after destroy (sync)`. So `destroy()` emits `window-all-closed` synchronously, before `destroy()` returns and before `startLocalServer()` can run. The W-8 verification log exercised **Use this computer** only from the connect window (step 3 and step 4), where the connect window keeps a window alive; the menu/tray path was not run. The `menu.test.ts` cases check only that the item exists and its `enabled` state; they do not click it. Limitation: not reproduced in the full app, but the probe plus the handler at `main.ts:607-612` determines the outcome.
- Fix: keep one window alive across the switch. Two simple options: (a) in `useThisComputer()`, open the connect window first (it is already shown as the local server starts, and `closeConnectWhenLocalReady` closes it when the local window opens); or (b) add a `switchingModes` flag that the `window-all-closed` handler checks, set around `destroyDashboardWindows()` in `switchToLocal` and `openRemoteDashboard`, and cleared when the new main window exists. Add a test that calls the menu/tray handler in remote mode and asserts `app.quit` is not called.

## Non-blocking Findings

- **~ SHOULD — desktop tests are not in CI (pre-existing).** Root `vitest.config.ts` includes only `tests/**`, `src/**/__tests__/**` and `packages/**`; `vitest.workspace.ts` lists `apps/desktop/vitest.config.ts`, but the CI shards run `npx vitest run --configLoader runner --shard=N/4` against the root config. The five pre-existing desktop test files were already outside CI, so the six new files (`boot`, `connect-window`, `connection`, `machine-client`, `machine-store`, `machine-url`) are not exercised by the CI test job either. Checked: root vitest is 4.1.11 (workspace files are no longer loaded); `npx vitest list --configLoader runner tests/unit/lib/agents` lists `[root]` tests, while `npx vitest list --configLoader runner apps/desktop/tests/boot.test.ts` lists nothing. I ran the desktop tests locally (below). Pre-existing gap, not this author's blocker; worth a follow-up issue.
- **? MAY — `will-redirect` is not guarded (D-9).** `guardRemoteNavigation` (`main.ts:340-352`) handles `will-navigate` and `setWindowOpenHandler`, but a server-side redirect of the main frame to another origin raises `will-redirect`, not `will-navigate`. The remote server is the operator's own paired machine, so there is no present exposure; adding `will-redirect` with the same check would make FR-10 complete.
- **? MAY — same-origin `window.open` children get no navigation guard.** A child window allowed by `setWindowOpenHandler` inherits the partition and preload but is not passed through `guardRemoteNavigation`. Low impact for the same reason as above.
- **≉ SHOULD NOT — `RESTART_DASHBOARD`'s inline ready callback (`main.ts:286-292`) calls `setLocalDashboard(serverUrl)` without the remote-mode guard that `onLocalServerReady` has.** A restart can only begin in local mode (remote mode throws first), and the 500 ms window before respawn is the only race, so this is bounded. Reusing `onLocalServerReady` there would remove the duplication.
- **Pairing revokes the old device before the new record is proven to open.** `pairWithMachine` revokes the previous device (`machine-client.ts:205-212`) and saves the new record `active: true` before `openRemoteDashboard` runs its preflight. If that preflight then fails, the app is left with the new record active and the connect window showing the reason, which matches D-6 (no silent fallback). Noted only so the behavior is understood; no change requested.
- Spec note, not a defect: the W-8 log documents that over plain loopback a revoked token still mints (loopback root mint), so the FR-5 "revoked" message cannot appear for a loopback base URL. This is server behavior outside NFR-2 scope; the author verified the non-loopback path with a proxy.

### Dimensions
- Correctness: one blocker (above); remaining flows traced — boot remote/local, failed-preflight connect window, pair from local and from remote, Open, Forget, late local-server callback guard.
- Security: token never sent to a renderer (getState projects label/origin only), never written in plaintext (safeStorage ciphertext; in-memory partition), sent only after transport policy + descriptor id check; connect IPC rejects foreign senders; connect page has a strict CSP and no innerHTML. Remote page keeps `overdeckBridge` by design (D-8). No server or frontend change (NFR-2 confirmed: no file under src/dashboard or src/lib changed).
- Performance: tray polling and menu workspace fetch reuse existing intervals and timeouts; all new requests carry a 5 s timeout; DNS lookup is async. No concern.
- Requirements/UX: see matrix.

### Acceptance criteria

| AC-7 menu/tray | met as written, but FR-6 unmet | menu.test.ts passes; `grep serverUrl` in menu.ts/tray.ts prints nothing. Clicking the item quits the app on Linux/Windows (blocker) |

| AC-9 docs | met | sections present; `grep "environment switcher"` prints nothing |
| FR-6 switching | **unmet** for the menu/tray path | blocker above |

## Verification
- CI on exact HEAD 96a5138c (`gh pr checks 4665`): all checks pass — build (22), lint, lint-group core/effect/skills/state, test-shard 1–4, test, test-e2e, clean install smoke, overdeck/test verification gate. `lint:effect-diagnostics` covered by the passing lint-group (effect) job on this HEAD.
- Local, focused: `cd apps/desktop && npx tsc --noEmit` → exit 0; `cd apps/desktop && npx vitest run --configLoader runner` → 11 files, 120 tests passed.
- Isolated probe: Electron 40.10.6 in a scratch directory — `destroy()` of the only window emits `window-all-closed` and `before-quit` synchronously.
- Not run: full desktop app E2E (author's W-8 log reused); dist rebuild comparison (would overwrite tracked files).
